steps.content: Pacassi looks at herself in the floor-to-ceiling mirror in the mall and speaks to you somewhat embarrassedly.

steps.speaker: Pacassi
steps.content: This jacket...

steps.speaker: Pacassi
steps.content: Constrains my movement. And the fabric is too thin...

options: It's time to buy some new clothes.

choices.text: It's time to buy some new clothes.

steps.speaker: Pacassi
steps.content: Thank you...

steps.speaker: Pacassi
steps.content: But...
You should buy some more summer outfits too. It's not good to always wear such thick layers.

steps.speaker: Pacassi
steps.content: I don't mind heat that much...
How about trying something else?
In this Eastside's busiest commercial street, Pacassi, who got dragged out by you, seems slightly uncomfortable being faced with a dazzling array of items.

steps.speaker: Pacassi
steps.content: I'm... really not used to this.
You need to relax.

steps.speaker: Pacassi
steps.content: Life at the Bureau is very relaxed already.
Pacassi speaks as she watches the bustling passersby and vehicles, and flinches back slightly timidly.
If you don't like it here, why don't we go somewhere else?

steps.speaker: Pacassi
steps.content: ...I don't have any place I want to go.

options: There's a place you will be interested in.

choices.text: There's a place you will be interested in.

steps.content: You can see Pacassi feeling slightly helpless.
You hold Pacassi's hands as you walk along the garden street. It's a nice day, and the sun sprinkles through the leaves onto the ground.
You walk down the long road, and a huge billboard comes into view.

steps.speaker: Pacassi
steps.content: Is this... Nastia?
On the billboard is an old lady, surrounded by children, with a heartfelt smile on her face.
Do you remember what she looked like? You were very young when she left Mayek, right?

steps.speaker: Pacassi
steps.content: Yeah, I do remember.
It says here that she's a celebrity tutor at this language school now. Seems like she's doing well.
How about we go see her together?

steps.speaker: Pacassi
steps.content: It's okay.

steps.speaker: Pacassi
steps.content: She may not recognize me. Even if she does, seeing me will only bring back unpleasant memories for her.
You say nothing. Going around the corner, you two come to a restaurant.
This is it.

steps.speaker: Pacassi
steps.content: As I told you, I don't need to eat.
They make really good borscht here. Wanna try?

steps.speaker: Pacassi
steps.content: Alright.
Pacassi replies very quietly. You take her hand and walk in.
The restaurant is doing well with many customers inside. Fortunately, you have already made a reservation. The waiter leads you to your seats.
After taking a seat, Pacassi skims through the menu and stops at one of the pages.

steps.speaker: Pacassi
steps.content: Borsc... Beet soup and bread, please.

steps.speaker: Waiter
steps.content: Is that all, Miss?
Looking at the waiter's slightly awkward smile, you sigh and take the menu.
Any recommendations?

steps.speaker: Waiter
steps.content: I strongly recommend our strawberry parfait for the two of you.

steps.speaker: Pacassi
steps.content: Parfait is... ice cream, right?

steps.speaker: Waiter
steps.content: That's right.

steps.speaker: Pacassi
steps.content: I'm alright, thanks.
You order a few more dishes, and the waiter hurries back to the kitchen.
It's noon time, and the restaurant is packed with customers. Thankfully, the restaurant is very speedy in serving food. It doesn't take long before the dishes are brought to the table.
Pacassi breaks the bread into small pieces and soaks them in the soup before putting it in her mouth—a way of eating rarely seen in the DisCity.
How is it? Do you like it?

steps.speaker: Pacassi
steps.content: Okay.
Does it taste familiar to you?

steps.speaker: Pacassi
steps.content: ...uh-huh.
Pacassi nods.
This restaurant is owned by Leroy.
Pacassi puts down the silverware as her eyes widen.
As she looks around at the restaurant packed with customers, Pacassi smiles in relief.

steps.speaker: Pacassi
steps.content: Looks like he's doing great.
Indeed. They're all doing great.
Do you still remember all these people?
You take a group photo out from your inside pocket.

steps.speaker: Pacassi
steps.content: This is... Boris? Victoria, Nastia... Leroy? Why are they all together?
The Mayekens have begun their new lives in the DisCity.
They even formed a support group. I met with them the other day—they are very happy to take you in.

steps.speaker: Pacassi
steps.content: I'm... a Sinner.

steps.speaker: Pacassi
steps.content: They can't help me, and neither can I help them.
You should give it a chance. Maybe they can help you put your past behind...

steps.speaker: Pacassi
steps.content: ...I don't deserve it.
Silence falls. Pacassi quickly finishes the soup in front of her.

steps.speaker: Pacassi
steps.content: Let's go.
No need to rush. We have the whole afternoon.

steps.speaker: Pacassi
steps.content: Where else... are we going?
You hear resignation in Pacassi's voice, but also veiled excitement.

options: I promise you're going to like this.

choices.text: I promise you're going to like this.

steps.content: You two come to a gray building, which seems to be still under renovation. You wave at the Bureau staff by the entrance.
How's the project going?

steps.speaker: Staff
steps.content: Everything's great! It'll be open for visits next week by the latest.
What about the real estate contract?

steps.speaker: Staff
steps.content: That's not a problem. We found the original contract. In the initial allocation, the FAC didn't specify we had to use it as a depot.

steps.speaker: Staff
steps.content: It doesn't matter if this is turned into a nightclub. It'll still be the Bureau's property.
Workers are carefully unloading some old equipment off the truck on the side.

steps.speaker: Pacassi
steps.content: Is this...

steps.speaker: Pacassi
steps.content: The hot spring pipes in pre-Nightfall Mayek?

steps.speaker: Pacassi
steps.content: You guys... went to Mayek?
You smile without directly answering Pacassi's question.
There's more inside. Let's go in and have a look.
Inside the building, the limited space is divided into several areas, with several "exhibits" in each area.

steps.speaker: Pacassi
steps.content: A reactor core, levers, and even the broadcasting station.

steps.speaker: Pacassi
steps.content: They're all here...
Pacassi names the "garbage" one by one, as if they are family treasures.
I've moved all your memories in Mayek here.
Pacassi's voice trembles. She takes a few steps back and hides in the shadows.

steps.speaker: Pacassi
steps.content: ...Please stop wasting time on me.
How can it be a waste of time?
Pacassi tugs at the corner of her jacket and says nothing.
You never eat unless you feel weak.

steps.speaker: Pacassi
steps.content: I don't need to...
You don't take any rest during battles, and neither do you ever think about your own safety.
You've helped me a lot. You've helped us all a lot. You're always so thoughtful to those around you.

steps.speaker: Pacassi
steps.content: I'm just doing what I should do.
You have things you like and things you want to talk about too... You don't have any sin. Even if you had, you would've redeemed yourself long ago.
You don't have to always be so humble. Try to accept kindness from your friends once in a while.
As the noise from the power switch reverberates, warm lights illuminate the entire hall.
Now let me present to you...
You take a piece of paper out of your pocket and read the words on it out loud.
Welcome to the land's northernmost part, a place where people battled against natural disasters with ancient nuclear technology and determination for a whole century without using Hypercubes.
Though the town no longer exists, its stories and people will continue to live.
This is the Mayek Museum. Please join me in witnessing the heroic town...
You turn around again and extend your hand toward Pacassi.
Do you like the opening speech? I'm going to have it engraved on the museum entrance.
Pacassi slowly steps forward out of the shadows.

steps.speaker: Pacassi
steps.content: Thank you.
Tears glisten in her eyes, yet her lips can't stop curling into a smile.

steps.speaker: Pacassi
steps.content: I love it...
